annotation.title_clean: U.S. Leadership in AI: A Plan for Federal Engagement in Developing Technical Standards and Related Tools
annotation.title_en: U.S. Leadership in AI: A Plan for Federal Engagement in Developing Technical Standards and Related Tools
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: NIST plan, prepared under Executive Order 13859, for federal engagement in developing AI technical standards and related tools. It sets priorities, levels of agency engagement, and four recommendations to keep U.S. AI leadership through voluntary consensus standards, research, public-private partnerships and international engagement. Robotics and vehicle standards appear only as examples.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designate an NSTC ML/AI Subcommittee Standards Coordinator to coordinate agency standards activity.
Agencies should engage in AI standards at four levels: monitoring, participating, influencing, leading.
Prioritize consensus-based, open, inclusive, globally relevant and non-discriminatory standards efforts.
Fund research on metrics, benchmarks and testbeds to embed trustworthiness in standards.
Engage internationally to champion U.S. AI standards priorities and track foreign strategies.
